The bars are not sorted in descending (or any) order. The values are -26.07, -28.67, -17.65, -36, -35.31.
The longest bar corresponds to the SH category, which has a value of -36. The MV bar has a value of -28.67.
The shortest bar corresponds to the HH category, which has a value of -17.65. The NI bar has a value of -26.07.
No bar has a value of -5%. The value for the misidentified 'shortest' bar (NI) is -26.07. The actual shortest bar (HH) has a value of -17.65.
